Of the four printed tables, three are measured - Table 1 on p5, Table 3 on p12 and the uncaptioned 'Notations | Definition' glossary above Table 1 - and Table 4 does not exist as a region: the p20 fit-index table ('Fit Test Index | Fit Standard | Model Result | Fit Evaluation', seven rows CMIN 1~3 / 1.774 / Good, RMSEA <0.08 / 0.083 / Acceptable, RMR <0.08 / 0.085 / Acceptable, GFI >0.90 / 0.927 / Good, CFI >0.90 / 0.949 / Good, IFI >0.90 / 0.944 / Good, TLI >0.90 / 0.985 / Good) is set as plain text with only two horizontal rules, one above the header and one below the last row, so no ruled grid survives the 0.5% area and 25 pt side thresholds; it is declared a third gap. Table 2 on p8 is printed as a numbered table but holds a bordered pseudo-code listing with no columns and no data rows, so it is recorded as a table-as-figure item rather than a grid. Numbering and placement defects, as printed: p7 cites 'the algorithm in Table 3' while the EM algorithm is printed as Table 2 on p8 and Table 3 is the representative-country list on p12; the caption lines of Figures 4, 6 and 9 carry stray decorative glyphs from the watermark layer in the text layer ('Figure 4: Clustering of attacking and victim countries 2 ...', 'Figure 6: Parallel Trend Test ...', 'Figure 9: Kaplan-Meier survival curve ...'), and the record quotes the printed words only; Figure 1's caption prints above the '2 Assumptions and Justifications' heading, so it belongs to 1.3 Our Work; Figure 5's caption prints above the 5.3 heading and belongs to 5.2.2; Figure 9's caption prints above the '6.5 Model Building' heading, so it sits in 6.4, which only exists on the zero-text sheet 16; Figure 12's caption prints above the 7.3 heading and belongs to 7.2; Figure 13's caption prints above the '9 Strengths and Weaknesses' heading and belongs to 8.
